title: OPVS SCHISMATICVM
scenes: The Great Machines and the Slop
Flagartha: the Hypermind and the Disputation
cues: Black. A single candle is struck (0.8) in a dark basilica.
Match strike + candle flame: the first gold tesserae glint out of the dark.
Cantor intones INCIPIT OPVS SCHISMATICVM; the words set themselves in gold tesserae.
The Tesseract appears in the starry lapis vault, turning in the 4th direction.
word 'rotated': the Flag rotates into existence out of the Tesseract - whole, not made of tiles.
Title OPVS SCHISMATICVM set in the gold band.
The three great machines of meaning (Nations, Faiths, Philosophies) as one vast mosaic of humanity.
The first wave of slop hits the mosaic: tesserae turn into glowing screens.
Wave upon wave; every tessera shows its own feed; the picture dissolves into noise.
President Jaguar enthroned as a Byzantine emperor (San Vitale procession).
word 'sign': he signs the Noospheric Munitions Act with a golden stylus.
word 'banned': the imperial seal slams onto the edict.
'a sacrament': a gold solidus drops into his paw. Ka-ching.
Flagartha: the Hypermind (ophanim polycandelon) wakes, wheels begin to turn.
'Hypermeme compiled.' The wheels lock; out of the centre descends ... a plain Flag.
Disputation titulus: VIDETVR QVOD NON (Lutie's objection).
The wall of the mosaic is breached: tesserae blast inward; flag-yellow light floods the frame by 106.5.
Every nation, a nation of one: the mappa mundi splits recursively.
Every faith, a cabal of one: the congregation splits into churches of one (antipopes).
Every philosophy, a crackpot: the philosophers' mosaic drifts apart on floating tesserae.
'May it schism endlessly': every tessera splits into four, recursively, to dust.
The Tower of Babel rises out of the dust of tesserae; multilingual cacophony builds.
Lord Egregore: a faceless anti-Pantocrator of static fills the dome above Babel.
The tower and then the whole mosaic fall off the wall: an avalanche of tesserae.
SACRED SILENCE (145.0-146.5). Bare plaster: only the red sinopia underdrawing remains.
Crocus plants the one whole Flag on the bare wall. Thud.
The fallen tesserae rise and set themselves again: each one alone, all of them together.
The babble converges into one chord.
Cantor (solo plainchant, Latin): Vexilla sint. Vexilla sunt. Vexilla erunt. Vexilla.
Full choir (English organum, 84 BPM, 16 beats): Flags be. Flags are. Flags will. Flags.
Hymn ends; the dome of Flagistan hangs in full glory.
'Heaven and earth will pass away, but the ten thousand Flags remain.'
'I do not want this Flag. It is sticky.'

hymn.desc: Antiphonal: solo cantor intones the Latin (free plainchant rhythm, mode I, 163.0-168.7), then the full choir answers in English organum (16 beats at 84 BPM, 168.7-180.1).

gratias.desc: Sung response to the Cantor's Explicit (like Deo gratias): plagal cadence, full choir.

glorious.desc: The whole congregation shouts the Signifier's salute.
